text_block_list.text:
Т.М. Опера О has been feeling tired, so
I take her
to the infirmary for some rest.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Even the Overlord must refrain from
overwork.
Until we meet again, Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
...Oh? What in the world is going on
here?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
The Brilliant Nation of Opera O is most
worthy of
the multitalented mastermind
that is Lady Opera
O!
text_block_list.name: Commoner A

text_block_list.text:
No! The noble, majestic Lady Opera O
should
come to the Opera O Grand
Nation!
text_block_list.name: Commoner B

text_block_list.text:
What is happening here? Two nations at
war over
me?!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Stop this at once! Pointless conflicts
bring nothing
but sorrow.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Lady Opera O?!
text_block_list.name: The Masses

text_block_list.text:
Yearn for me all you wish, but I will only
ever be
mine. Even the Three Goddesses
are powerless to
change that!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Wh-what are we to do?!
text_block_list.name: The Masses

text_block_list.text:
Listen well! Do not lose heart, unnamed
followers
of my cause.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
As an apology... please soothe your
wounded
hearts by basking in my
beauty.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Feast your eyes on... MY BRILLIANCE!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! Its shimmer stretches as far as the
eye can
see!
text_block_list.name: Commoner A

text_block_list.text:
This magnificent light! I must peer into it
longer,
even if for just one more second!
text_block_list.name: Commoner B

text_block_list.text:
Now do you understand? There are
better things
to do than hate and bicker.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Namely, praising this marvelous work of

art—granted unto you by the gods
above—that is
I, Т.М. Опера О!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Go on, shower me with adoring
admiration!
Haaah ha ha... Huh?!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
A dream? Heh, yet another legend of
the
Overlord has been born.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Aaargh! M-my eyes! I-I can't see
anything!
text_block_list.name: The Masses

text_block_list.text:
Alas! Is my brilliance too blinding for
them to
behold?!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Hear me, one and all! You must endure!
Everyone!
Every—
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Ah! A dream, it was!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Oh, those poor souls... And all because
of my
overwhelming beauty!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
It seems Т.М. Опера О feels too guilty
to focus on
her recovery.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Т.М. Опера О wakes up in an amazing
mood,
completely back to her usual self!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
